name: @coro/desktop-electron
description: Coro Desktop Shell — Electron wrapper for the Coro runner and dashboard
author: Coro

scripts.build: pnpm run build:bundle && pnpm run prepare:icon && pnpm run prepare:resources
scripts.build:bundle: tsup src/main.ts src/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist --clean --target node20 --external electron --sourcemap
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --arm64 --publish always
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json5 --win nsis --x64 --publish always
